wrong.why: The Hebrew lists Eliel the Mahavite separately and identifies only Jeribai and Joshaviah as the sons of Elnaam.

missing.why: The Hebrew calls Jashobeam ben-Hachmoni, explicitly stating sonship beyond the recorded ancestor relationship.

note: Parallel-list name variants were retained. The owner's Shiza–Reuben ruling is supported by the designation 'the Reubenite.'
